newsitem.title: UK: Norwich shares to be offered at 240p-290p.
newsitem.headline: Norwich shares to be offered at 240p-290p.

text.p: British insurer Norwich Union NRU.CN said on Wednesday it expects its shares to be priced at between 240 pence and 290 pence as part of plans to raise 1.75 billion pounds of fresh capital ahead of its flotation on June 16.
Members will receive a fixed discount of 25 pence to the offer price if they wish to buy extra shares in the group.
Nearly three million Norwich members are to receive free shares in the company under plans already announced when it floats next month.
The insurer said it expected to be valued at between 4.9 and 5.6 billion pounds on flotation which would put it in the FTSE 100 index of the country's largest quoted companies.

"Norwich Union is keen to encourage members to continue to participate in the future of the group. I hope that they will take advantage of this opportunity to buy further shares at a 25p discount," said Norwich chairman George Paul.
The discount to members represents a saving of around 40 pounds on the minimum investment of 400 pounds worth of shares.
At least 800 million pounds worth of shares have been reserved to meet applications fronm members. This may be increased in the event of strong demand from members.
The final members' offer price will be announced after the close of the offer and will be used to determine how many shares succesful applicants receive.
Mini-prospectus and application forms are to be sent to members today. The deadline for receipt of applications is June 10.
